results.summary:
Summary:
- The page details Claude pricing from Anthropic, with all prices in USD.
- It lists model-specific costs, including base input tokens, cache writes, cache hits/refresher, and output tokens for each Claude model (e.g., Claude Fable 5.1, Claude Opus 5.5, Claude Sonnet series, Claude Haiku, etc.). Prices vary by model and component (e.g., base input tokens around $2-$10 per MTok for some models, higher for outputs; cache write/hit costs also specified).
- It notes that cloud platform pricing (Amazon Bedrock, Google Cloud, Microsoft Foundry) uses Claude Consumption Units (CCUs) billed via the respective marketplaces, with conversion from USD to CCUs at $0.01 per CCU and hourly reporting.
- Regional pricing may include a 10% premium in certain regions and data residency considerations.
- There are also sections on platform-specific pricing (Claude Platform on AWS, Claude in Microsoft Foundry) and feature-specific pricing, such as prompt caching (cost/latency reduction by reusing prompts).

If you want, I can pull out the exact per-model rates for a specific Claude model or summarize the CCU conversion process.
